description.narrative: CDC launched the company in January 2018. It is run by an independent board and management team. Our investment is to support the financing of renewable power generation capacity to: displace thermal generation and avoid greenhouse gas emissions; increase the supply of reliable and clean electricity to industry to support power enabling jobs; and increase the supply of reliable and clean electricity to grid-connected households to meet the needs of consumers.
